title: Post ready cooldowns to raid chat
quote: When I'm over voice calling the next phase I want one click that tells the raid which defensives are up, so my healers stop asking in chat.
what: A button and a slash command that post one short line to raid chat (or only to officers), like 'Ready now: Aura Mastery (Kyle), Barrier (Ann), Tranquility (Joe). Used: Spirit Link (back in 2:10)'. You pick which spells go in the line.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (only players running the addon can be listed); possible on Era, TBC and MoP for everyone
today: Today: only Request Rez posts to chat; no summary post exists (CooldownCollaborator.lua RequestRez)

title: Next up order for a cooldown
quote: I rotate Hand of Sacrifice and Guardian Spirit through the same few people, and I want the list to show who is next.
what: The leader sets an order for a spell (Kyle, then Ann, then Joe). The panel marks the next player in line who is ready, and moves to the following one when that cooldown is used. The order can be shared to other addon users.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (only knows casts by addon users); possible on Era, TBC and MoP for all
today: Today: rows are listed per player with no order or assignment; Request Rez just takes the first ready provider

title: Raid defensive count in one number
quote: I don't want to read 25 rows mid-pull, I want to see '4 of 6 raid cooldowns ready' and nothing else.
what: A small header on the Essentials bar that counts ready raid-wide cooldowns (the leader picks which spells count) out of how many exist in the raid. Colour changes when it drops under a number you set.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (counts only addon users); possible on Era, TBC and MoP
today: Today: Essentials shows only lust and Battle Rez providers plus a flask/food count; other spells only appear in the full panel

title: Who is missing flask or food, by name
quote: A count of '18 of 25 flasked' tells me nothing, I need to know whose name to say on voice.
what: Click the flask or food count to see the names without it, and post them to raid chat with one click. Names come from the same status each player already shares.
possible: Partly on every client: only players running the addon report a status, so others show as 'unknown', not 'missing'
today: Today: the strip shows a count, not names; status only comes from addon users (Consumables.lua, CDCBUFF)

title: Single point of failure warning
quote: If my only Bloodlust shaman dies or leaves, I want to know before the next pull, not when I call lust.
what: A warning on the Essentials bar when a resource is down to one provider, when its last provider is dead or offline, or when the raid has none at all. It can also print once at roster change.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (the roster is known, but cooldown state needs the addon); possible on Era, TBC and MoP
today: Today: Essentials shows 'No providers in group' and a count, with no alert and no dead or leaver check

title: Rez queue for dead players
quote: On a messy wipe I have six dead and two rez charges, and I want the addon to tell me who gets rezzed first and by whom.
what: A list of dead raid members ordered by a priority you set (healers, then tanks, then damage), each paired with a ready Battle Rez provider. One button calls the top entry and moves to the next.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (provider readiness needs the addon); possible on Era, TBC and MoP. Charges count is secret in combat on Retail, so no maths on it for other players
today: Today: Request Rez handles one dead target at a time, picked by you, and picks the first ready provider

title: Rez providers to skip
quote: I never want my main healer's Rebirth or Soulstone called unless there is no one else.
what: The leader marks players or roles as 'last choice' or 'never'. Request Rez and the queue pass over them and only fall back if nobody else is ready.
possible: Possible on every client (it is a choice among already known providers)
today: Today: Request Rez only skips dead providers and the target (CooldownCollaborator.lua RequestRez); no preference list
